headline: Pennsylvania would bar schools from using AI counseling
text:
Here is how your fear of AI is being used to centralize power today.

Pennsylvania would bar schools from using artificial intelligence for school-based mental health and counseling services. Not passed. It cites the fear that an AI is standing in for a therapist.

380 measures in 48 jurisdictions would ban or restrict a use of AI, or make one a crime.

36 measures in 24 jurisdictions cite the fear that an AI is standing in for a therapist.

2,224 measures tracked. 751 carry a control, and they would hand new power to 101 offices.
